items.title: How long aseptic milk lasts
items.claim: Tetra Pak's aseptic packaging (developed in Sweden in the 1950s-60s) allows long ambient storage. How long can typical UHT milk stay unopened at room temperature?
items.reveal_title: Half a year or more without refrigeration
items.reveal:
UHT-treated milk in aseptic cartons typically keeps for 6 to 9 months sealed at ambient temperature. This transformed dairy supply chains in countries with weak cold storage.

The packaging itself combines paper, polymer and aluminium layers.
items.why: A packaging innovation can change which products are commercially viable in which regions.

items.title: Riveted jeans patent
items.claim: Levi Strauss and Jacob Davis patented riveted denim trousers. In which year?
items.reveal:
Davis, a Nevada tailor, had the rivet idea; Strauss provided the cloth and patent capital. The trouser was a workwear product for miners and labourers for most of its first century.

Global denim production now exceeds 7 billion pairs per year.
items.why: A small mechanical detail can define a category for over 150 years.

items.title: Female crash-test dummies
items.claim: Standard crash-test dummies are based on male physiology. When was a regulated female-sized dummy widely required in US tests?

options.text: Female-sized dummies were not required in US frontal crash tests until 2003 and a fully biofidelic female dummy is still under development

items.reveal_title: Required test dummies under-represented women for decades
items.reveal:
Caroline Criado Perez (Invisible Women, 2019) and NHTSA documents show female-sized dummies only became required in some US frontal tests from 2003, and a more biofidelic THOR-AV female dummy is still being developed.

Women face higher serious-injury risk in comparable crashes.
items.why: Standardised testing reflects the assumptions of its designers and reshapes downstream safety for those left out.
